newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Colonial capital reduction confirmed.
newsitem.headline: Colonial capital reduction confirmed.

text.p: Colonial Motor Co Ltd said on Tuesday that the High Court had confirmed the capital reduction approved by shareholders in February.
Colonial is cancelling four out of every five shares and returning NZ$0.50 to shareholders for each share cancelled. The remaining 50 cent shares will be subdivided into five shares of 10 cents each.
The proposed books closing date is April 11.
"The company intends to effect the capital reduction, and make payments to shareholders in respect of the reduction, as soon as practicable after the books closing date," Colonial said.
The company will reregister under the Companies Act 1993 once the capital reduction is effected. Court approval was required under the previous 1955 act.
